recallExpandTop.description: How many of the returned facts are shown with the conversation behind them. 0 keeps recall a list of sentences.

recallExpandChars.description: Characters of conversation kept on each side of the point a fact came from.

agentTools.description: Register the graphiti_* tools so agents can query and write memory on demand. Which agent may call which tool is still governed by the OpenClaw per-agent tool allowlist.

excludeSessionPatterns.description: Regular expressions tested against the OpenClaw session key and the run trigger. A match excludes the session from both capture and recall. Replaces the previously hardcoded cron/heartbeat/subagent/slug-generator filtering; overriding this list overrides that too.

browseChars.description: Characters of conversation graphiti_browse reads on each side of an anchor by default.

browseMaxChars.description: Ceiling on before/after in one graphiti_browse call.

browseMaxEpisodes.description: How many anchors graphiti_browse will expand in one call.

browseMaxTotalChars.description: Total size of one graphiti_browse reply. What does not fit is reported as omitted rather than silently dropped.

agentDbPath.description: Path to an agent's OpenClaw transcript store; {agentId} is substituted. Empty uses ~/.openclaw/agents/{agentId}/agent/openclaw-agent.sqlite.

adoptExistingHistoryOnFirstSight.description: Skip a session's existing rows the first time it is seen. Off by default; only correct when that history is already in memory and reading it again would duplicate episodes.

recallPool.description: How many candidates recall examines before choosing recallLimit of them. 0 keeps them the same number.

recallRerank.description: Score candidates with a cross-encoder against the message just sent, instead of fusing search methods by rank.

recallMinScore.description: Below this a fact is not injected. Null keeps whatever the search recipe declares.

recallContextMinScore.description: Floor for the second pass, scored against the conversation and taken only when the first pass admitted nothing.

recallMinSpread.description: How much the top and bottom of a ranking must differ, as a fraction of the top, for it to count as a ranking. A reranker asked what it cannot answer scores everything about the same, high.

recallVectorMinScore.description: Cosine floor on what the vector search returns at all. Null leaves the library's 0.6, which makes a wide pool arrive narrow.
